about_the_game:
Game Introduction:

"DeskAlchemy: Fairy Mine Tales"is an idle to light storyline role-playing game;

In the game, you live in a small town as a waiter in an inn, living an ordinary life and doing ordinary work every day; On an adventure, you encountered talking groundhogs and discovered a cave that produced various minerals, which greatly changed your life;

You can become a mining master and dig out all the rare ores in the cave, or you can become a casting master and turn rare ores into various weapons and accessories; You can sell raw ore, or sell finished products to earn money, or give them as gifts to friends you meet in town to open up different connections

Main gameplay:

Fingertip interaction: The process of mining, refining, and forging in the game is entrusted to cute groundhogs, who silently work for you and occasionally appear on your desktop. They may be working, playing, resting, or bringing you good things; There are also legendary characters appearing on your desktop for their own needs; They may cross dimensions and have a friendly interaction with you in front of the screen, or they may interact with mice and rats. What will happen? Do you want to participate again?

Plot unlocking: The continuous improvement of mining, refining, and forging skills can lead to different items and different operations leading to different stories

Desktop mini game: eager to see all the stories? You can actively play mini games to improve skills and obtain items; Have you ever played classic groundhog? Let's see how good your eye and hand skills are? Or do you want to challenge a fully random groundhog with a desktop as the canvas? Mining, refining, forging, each process has its own unique mini game. Come and give it a try

short_description: "DeskAlchemy: Fairy Mine Tales" is an idle to light storyline role-playing game. In a small town in this fantasy world, groundhogs and cultivators transcend dimensions and appear on your computer desktop during the gaps between their lives, work, and cultivation.
